title: Consciousness+ subsumes consciousness as one aspect

statements.text: Subjects have causal powers and spatial extension that mere consciousness does not seem to supply. So there is likely a more expansive property, consciousness+, that subsumes consciousness as one aspect, enfolding conscious and non-conscious aspects in one property. Whether its non-phenomenal aspects can ever be grasped is doubtful.

sources.quote: there is a more expansive property, call it consciousness+, that subsumes consciousness as one aspect
Will we ever come to grasp the non-phenomenal aspects of consciousness+? I am cautiously pessimistic.
